record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Given a Hilbert function for a set of points in P^{n-1}, determine the possible graded Betti numbers of the defining ideals of point sets with that Hilbert function.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $R = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ be the homogeneous coordinate ring of projective space $\mathbb{P}^{n-1}$. For a finite set of points $X \subset \mathbb{P}^{n-1}$, let $I_X \subset R$ be its (saturated) defining homogeneous ideal, and let $A_X = R/I_X$ be its homogeneous coordinate ring. The Hilbert function of $X$ is $H_X(t) = \dim_k (A_X)_t$. The minimal graded free resolution of $I_X$ has the form
$$0 \to \bigoplus_j R(-j)^{\beta_{p,j}} \to \cdots \to \bigoplus_j R(-j)^{\beta_{1,j}} \to I_X \to 0,$$
and the integers $\beta_{i,j}(I_X) = \dim_k \operatorname{Tor}_i^R(I_X, k)_j$ are the graded Betti numbers of $I_X$.

Problem: Given an admissible Hilbert function $H$ of some finite set of points in $\mathbb{P}^{n-1}$, characterize all sequences $(\beta_{i,j})$ that occur as the graded Betti numbers of $I_X$ for some finite set of points $X \subset \mathbb{P}^{n-1}$ with Hilbert function $H_X = H$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of determining which sets of graded Betti numbers occur for reduced sets of points with a given Hilbert function is a long-standing, broadly studied question. Partial results are known (e.g., for small numbers of points, points on a conic, Gorenstein configurations after Diesel/Geramita), but no general characterization is known. The problem remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Betti numbers of points in projective space
status_evidence.snippet: Studies graded Betti numbers of ideals of finite sets of points in projective space.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational work establishing the framework but not giving a full characterization.

status_evidence.title: Powerful Invariants of Points (Susan Cooper)
status_evidence.snippet: Many people have tried to characterize the Hilbert functions and graded Betti numbers for a variety of families of sets of points.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the characterization problem remains an active area without a complete answer.

status_evidence.title: Reduced arithmetically Gorenstein schemes (Migliore et al.)
status_evidence.snippet: Shows that any set of graded Betti numbers allowed by Diesel occurs for a reduced set of points, addressing the Gorenstein case.
status_evidence.claim: Solves a special (Gorenstein) instance but not the general problem.
